questions.question: Which of the following is NOT compulsory equipment for a football referee?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**White flag**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A **White flag** is not a compulsory piece of equipment for a football referee.
 
• Essential equipment for a football referee includes items such as **watch(es), whistle(s), and red and yellow cards**.
 
• These tools help the referee manage the game, keep time, and enforce the rules effectively.
 
• Other non-compulsory items may be used at the referee's discretion but are not mandated by the official regulations.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Laws of the Game** are established by the International Football Association Board (IFAB) and specify the required equipment for referees.
 
• Referees must carry a **whistle** to signal the start and stop of play, and **red and yellow cards** to discipline players.
 
• They must also have a **watch** to keep track of the match time and any additional time to be added.
 
• While other items like notebooks, pens, and coin for the toss are commonly used, they are also not strictly compulsory.

questions.question: In cricket, a fast, head-high delivery of the ball is referred to as ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**bouncer**__

__
 
• A **bouncer** is a type of fast, short-pitched delivery in cricket that reaches the batsman at head height.
 
• This delivery is used primarily by fast bowlers to intimidate the batsman or to induce a mistake.
 
• The bouncer is a strategic delivery aimed at disrupting the batsman's concentration and forcing them into a defensive position.
 
• It can be a potent weapon in the bowler's arsenal when used effectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Grubber:** A delivery that stays very low after bouncing.
 
• **Duck:** A term used when a batsman gets out without scoring any runs.
 
• **Leg-bye:** Runs scored when the ball hits the batsman's body without hitting the bat.
 
• In cricket, various types of deliveries and terms are used to describe different aspects of the game, each having its own significance and strategic importance.

• **Golf** is a cross-country game in which a player strikes a small ball with various clubs from a series of starting points (teeing grounds) into a series of holes on a course.
 
• **Different Golf Scoring Formats:**
 
 
• **Stroke Play:** In this type of play, you are to take note of the strokes you’ve committed in each hole using the scorecard. At the end of the game, the player with the lowest strokes wins.
 
• **Match Play: **The difference is that a winner is defined in each hole – that is by comparing your number of strokes against your opponent’s. The player with fewer strokes wins the hole. At the end of the game, the player who won most of the holes wins.
 
• **Stableford system**: In this scoring format, which was named Dr. Stableford, what is taken into account to decide a winner is how well a player plays against his own handicap. This is done by converting under, even, and over strokes into points against par adjustment based on handicap. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Hockey is a term used to denote various types of both summer and winter team sports which originated on either an outdoor field, sheet of ice, or dry floor such as in a gymnasium.
 
• Baseball is a bat-and-ball sport played between two teams of nine players each, taking turns batting and fielding. 
 
• The game is in play when a player on the fielding team, called the pitcher, throws a ball that a player on the batting team tries to hit with a bat.
 
• Squash is **a racket and ball sport played by two or four players in a four-walled court with a small, hollow rubber ball**. 
 
• The players alternate in striking the ball with their rackets onto the playable surfaces of the four walls of the court.
